featured_reviews.name: Avinash Zire
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located near Pestom Sagar Road No. 4 in Chembur, Flavours Of China is a great destination for anyone who loves authentic and flavour-packed Chinese cuisine. The restaurant is easy to locate and sits in a lively area, making it convenient for both quick meals and relaxed dining with friends or family. As you enter, you’re welcomed by a cozy ambience, neat interiors, and comfortable seating that instantly puts you at ease.

One of the highlights of Flavours Of China is the food quality, especially the soups. The soup is absolutely delicious—rich in flavour, perfectly seasoned, and served hot, making it a perfect start to the meal. It feels comforting and freshly prepared, setting the tone for the rest of the dining experience. From classic Chinese starters to hearty main-course dishes, every item reflects attention to taste and presentation. The balance of spices is impressive, and the ingredients feel fresh and well cooked.

The menu offers a good variety of vegetarian and non-vegetarian options, so everyone finds something they enjoy. Portions are generous, and the food is filling without being overly heavy. Noodles, rice dishes, and gravies are all prepared with consistent quality, making the restaurant a reliable choice for repeat visits.

Service here deserves special mention. The staff are polite, attentive, and quick to respond, ensuring that orders arrive on time and any requests are handled smoothly. Pricing is reasonable and offers good value for money considering the taste, portion size, and overall experience.

Overall, Flavours Of China near Pestom Sagar Road No. 4 is a solid choice for Chinese food lovers. With delicious soup, tasty dishes, friendly service, and a pleasant ambience, it’s definitely worth visiting if you’re in Chembur.

featured_reviews.name: Ambalal
featured_reviews.review_text:
# A Hidden Gem: Rare Kitchen

**Rating: 4.5/5 stars**

Tucked away on a quiet side street downtown, Rare Kitchen proved to be one of those delightful discoveries that makes you feel like you've uncovered a local secret. From the moment we stepped through the rustic wooden door, the warm ambiance and aromatic blend of garlic, herbs, and fresh bread set the stage for what would become a memorable evening.

## The Atmosphere
The interior strikes a perfect balance between cozy and elegant, with exposed brick walls adorned with vintage Italian photographs and soft lighting from wrought-iron fixtures. The gentle hum of conversation creates an intimate setting that's ideal for both romantic dinners and casual gatherings with friends.

## The Food
Our server, Maria, was knowledgeable and genuinely enthusiastic about the menu. We started with the burrata appetizer – a creamy, indulgent portion served with perfectly ripe tomatoes and a drizzle of aged balsamic that had us savoring every bite.

For mains, the handmade pappardelle with wild boar ragu was exceptional. The pasta had that perfect al dente texture you can only get from fresh noodles, and the rich, slowly-simmered sauce spoke of hours of careful preparation. My dining companion's osso buco was equally impressive – the meat fell off the bone, and the risotto beneath was creamy perfection.

## Service
The service struck that sweet spot of being attentive without being intrusive. Our water glasses never went empty, and Maria checked in at just the right moments. When we mentioned celebrating an anniversary, they surprised us with a complimentary tiramisu that was the perfect end to our meal.

## Value
While not bargain dining, the prices are fair for the quality and portion sizes. Entrees range from $18-28, and given the fresh ingredients and evident care in preparation, it feels like good value.

## Minor Notes
The only small critique would be that the acoustics can make it slightly noisy when full, and reservations are definitely recommended as this place fills up quickly – a testament to its quality.

**Would I return?** Absolutely. Rare Kitchen has earned a spot on our regular rotation, and I'm already planning to bring friends who appreciate authentic Italian cuisine served with genuine hospitality.

Visited this place with my friends after hearing a lot about it, and it truly lived up to the expectations. We had a fantastic experience—both the food and the overall vibe were excellent.

We ordered Bombil fry as a starter, along with Prawns Thali and Surmai Thali. Every single dish was 10/10. Personally, whenever I try a new place for fish, I judge it by the taste of the Bombil fry—and this one was outstanding. It was extremely fresh, perfectly crispy, and the masala was well balanced and nicely blended.

The same quality and freshness reflected in the Surmai and Prawns thali—authentic taste and very satisfying portions.

On the owner’s suggestion, we also tried their Mutton Thali for a change, and it was surprisingly excellent. The mutton was fresh, tender, and full of flavour, which is rare to find these days.

If you’re a seafood lover, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy quality fish with great taste and vibes.

Had an amazing dining experience at Wok Hei, and it truly exceeded expectations. The ambiance is warm, vibrant, and perfect for enjoying authentic Chinese cuisine. From the very beginning, everything felt well-organized and welcoming.
We started with the Chef’s Crab Soup, which was rich, flavorful, and incredibly comforting. The balance of spices and the generous crab content made it stand out, setting a great tone for the meal. It was easily one of the highlights of our visit.
For the main course, we ordered the Chicken Chinese Sizzlers, served piping hot and full of bold flavors. The chicken was tender, the vegetables were fresh, and the sauce complemented the dish perfectly. The sizzling presentation added to the excitement, and the portion size was quite satisfying.
A special mention goes to Shraddha from the staff, who made our experience even better. She was courteous, attentive, and very helpful with recommendations. Her service was prompt and professional, ensuring we were comfortable throughout the meal.
Overall, Wok Hei delivers a fantastic combination of delicious food, great ambiance, and excellent service. It’s a perfect spot for anyone craving quality Chinese food, and I would highly recommend it. Looking forward to visiting again and exploring more from their menu. 🍽️🔥

featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Vicky, apologies if you didn't like the taste, but we are known in the locality for the quality and taste we offer at Mumbai Chinese, a quick call at the number could have sorted any issues you had faced with the food in a timely manner.

featured_reviews.name: prashant lohar
featured_reviews.review_text: Mumbai Chinese is a great spot for Indo-Chinese food lovers. The menu offers a wide variety of noodles, fried rice, Manchurian, soups, and starters that are full of flavor. The taste is perfectly balanced with authentic Chinese sauces and that signature Mumbai street-style twist. Portion sizes are generous, prices are pocket-friendly, and service is usually quick. Their schezwan chutney and crispy starters are a must-try. A perfect place for both dine-in and takeaway if you’re craving tasty Chinese food in Mumbai.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thanks Prashant
